fields.acceptance: Testscripts with a local bare origin and a fake gh, replacing run-ship-merge-tree-differs: (a) differing trees: wait-main calls gh workflow run <file> --ref main -f sha=<merge commit> exactly once across its polls, for a workflow on origin/main's tip declaring pull_request and workflow_dispatch with a sha input and a run-name referencing inputs.sha, and not for one declaring only push, keeps waiting while the fake run whose title holds that sha is in progress, and the run reaches close-out once it succeeds; (b) the fake dispatched run fails, is rerun once and fails again: main-green fails with a stop: line naming the merge commit and the failed check, and the run never reaches close-out; (c) differing trees and no dispatchable workflow: a stop: line naming the merge commit and saying no dispatchable workflow was found, with no gh workflow run call; (d) a run failed at wait-main by the old tree-differs stop, with a hand-written pre-#256 state file (pr, url, branch, head, checks, merge_commit only), dispatches and reaches close-out after rhiza run resume; (e) differing trees and a workflow declaring pull_request and workflow_dispatch but no sha input (and, separately, one whose run-name lacks inputs.sha): a stop: line naming the merge commit and that workflow file, with no gh workflow run call; (f) main advanced past the merge commit with a commit that adds the sha input to a workflow lacking it at the merge commit: the workflow is selected from origin/main's tip and dispatched, so selection follows the dispatched ref, not the merge commit.
fields.statement: When the merge commit's tree differs from the tested head's (main moved between the checks and the merge, or the PR was merged by a ship from before #256), ship-change's wait-main step runs CI on the merge commit instead of stopping: it selects the workflows under .github/workflows at origin/main's tip (the ref it dispatches on, whose definitions GitHub runs) that declare both a pull_request and a workflow_dispatch trigger, and dispatches each of them, once and recorded in the ship state file (`gh workflow run <file> --ref main -f sha=<merge commit>`), finds each dispatched run by the merge commit's sha in its display title (event workflow_dispatch) and waits for it to finish; a failed run's failed jobs are rerun once per merge commit as PR checks are, and a second failure fails main-green with a stop: line naming the merge commit and the failed checks, with no revert and no close-out. A selected workflow whose workflow_dispatch declares no `sha` input, or whose run-name does not reference inputs.sha, cannot pin or be found by the merge commit: the main step stops, before dispatching anything, with a stop: line naming the merge commit and that workflow file and saying it lacks the sha input or run-name. Differing trees with no selected workflow stop the main step with a stop: line naming the merge commit and saying no dispatchable workflow was found. A run stopped at, or still waiting in, wait-main whose ship state file was written before this change (pr, head, checks, merge_commit, no dispatch record) takes the same path when resumed.
